In addition to that it is possible to add the @Mapping annotation to a class. This annotation has the following properties:

items.source: In addition to the default sort options described in Paging and Sorting, Spring Data Elasticsearch provides the class org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.core.query.Order which derives from org.springframework.data.domain.Sort.Order. It offers additional parameters that can be sent to Elasticsearch when specifying the sorting of the result (see www.elastic.co/guide/en/elasticsearch/reference/7.15/sort-search-results.html).
items.translation: 除了分页和排序中描述的默认排序选项外，Spring Data Elasticsearch 还提供了类org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.core.query.Order，该类继承自org.springframework.data.domain.Sort.Order。 它在指定结果排序时提供了可发送给 Elasticsearch 的额外参数（参见www.elastic.co/guide/en/elasticsearch/reference/7.15/sort-search-results.html）。

items.source: About the filter query: It is not possible to use a CriteriaQuery here, as this query would be converted into a Elasticsearch nested query which does not work in the filter context. So only StringQuery or NativeQuery can be used here. When using one of these, like the term query above, the Elasticsearch field names must be used, so take care, when these are redefined with the @Field(name="…​") definition.
items.translation: 关于过滤查询：此处无法使用CriteriaQuery，因为该查询会被转换为 Elasticsearch 嵌套查询，而嵌套查询在过滤上下文中无法工作。因此，此处只能使用StringQuery或NativeQuery。当使用这些查询（如上面的 term 查询）时，必须使用 Elasticsearch 字段名称，因此在通过@Field(name="…​")定义重新命名这些字段时要格外小心。

items.source: This chapter covers additional support for Elasticsearch operations that cannot be directly accessed via the repository interface. It is recommended to add those operations as custom implementation as described in Custom Repository Implementations .
items.translation: 本章介绍了对无法通过存储库接口直接访问的 Elasticsearch 操作的额外支持。建议按照自定义存储库实现中的描述，将这些操作添加为自定义实现。

items.source: useServerConfiguration does not send any settings parameters, so the Elasticsearch server configuration determines them.
items.translation: `useServerConfiguration` 不发送任何设置参数，因此由 Elasticsearch 服务器配置决定这些参数。

items.source: settingPath refers to a JSON file defining the settings that must be resolvable in the classpath, it is possible to use a SpEL expression here

items.source: mappingPath a classpath resource in JSON format; if this is not empty it is used as the mapping, no other mapping processing is done.
items.translation: `mappingPath` 为 JSON 格式的类路径资源；如果该值不为空，则将其用作映射，不再执行其他映射处理。

items.source: enabled when set to false, this flag is written to the mapping and no further processing is done.

items.source: dynamicDateFormats when this String array is not empty, it defines the date formats used for automatic date detection.
items.translation: 当该字符串数组不为空时，`dynamicDateFormats` 定义了用于自动日期检测的日期格式。

items.source: Elasticsearch has a scroll API for getting big result set in chunks. This is internally used by Spring Data Elasticsearch to provide the implementations of the <T> SearchHitsIterator<T> SearchOperations.searchForStream(Query query, Class<T> clazz, IndexCoordinates index) method.
items.translation: Elasticsearch 提供了一个滚动 API，用于分块获取大型结果集。Spring Data Elasticsearch 内部使用该 API 来实现 <T> SearchHitsIterator<T> SearchOperations.searchForStream(Query query, Class<T> clazz, IndexCoordinates index) 方法。

items.source: To use the Scroll API with repository methods, the return type must defined as Stream in the Elasticsearch Repository. The implementation of the method will then use the scroll methods from the ElasticsearchTemplate.
items.translation: 要在存储库方法中使用滚动 API，必须在 Elasticsearch 存储库中将返回类型定义为 `Stream`。该方法的实现将使用 `ElasticsearchTemplate` 中的滚动方法。

items.source: There also is the org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.core.query.GeoDistanceOrder class which can be used to have the result of a search operation ordered by geographical distance.
items.translation: 此外，还有 `org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.core.query.GeoDistanceOrder` 类，可用于按地理距离对搜索操作的结果进行排序。

items.source: 1 create a point in time for an index (can be multiple names) and a keep-alive duration and retrieve its id 2 pass that id into the query to search together with the next keep-alive value 3 for the next query, use the id returned from the previous search 4 when done, close the point in time using the last returned id

items.source: 1 when defining sort fields, use the name of the Java property (firstField), not the name that might be defined for Elasticsearch (first_field) 2 sortModes, sortOrders and sortMissingValues are optional, but if they are set, the number of entries must match the number of sortFields elements
items.translation: 1. 在定义排序字段时，请使用 Java 属性的名称（firstField），而不是可能为 Elasticsearch 定义的名称（first_field）。 2. sortModes、sortOrders 和 sortMissingValues 是可选的，但如果设置了这些参数，其条目数量必须与 sortFields 元素的数量相匹配。
